system.description: (Air, (Air, Force 10) A silap is a great beast that lives on the edges of can the metaplanes of water and air, presumably crossing via the cardinal pole. Its shape is that of a dire on bear, approaching five meters tall when standing that on its hind legs. Massive fangs and claws arc with its energy as it charges its prey. It sometimes uses a from storm to separate prey from the pack, though it is 53 known to use the storm tactic to lure hunters off cliffs.
